allowlist: byte-identical copied nonsecret source-result and preflight-recovery raw/review records
scope: Package already saved exact source prep/source result, filled3templates, boundpins/decisions/reviews, preflight-receipts, failuredisposition/review. No private owner state, DB/media/access/secrets, broadlogs, old C data or new probes.
constraints: Only file copy/hash and JSON, no tests/import/lifecycle/Gitstatewrites/network; do not copy unrelated sourcecode tree or rerun source digest/preflight. Preserve latest source-result documentary correction with its review.
definition_of_done: Source clone0/checkout0 proof separate from preflight1/1/native2; no apply/start/GET, availability unconfirmed, cap2/3, explicit missing inner diagnostics and no delivery claim
